prepare_dataset_for_training: prepare a TensorFlow dataset with image preprocessing, cropping, augmentation, and classification/regression labels for galaxy merger data
resize_and_center_image: resize a galaxy image to a target size and pad or extract to maintain original dimensions with optional random centering
get_classification_label: get a classification label for a dataset row based on grounded normalized merge time and class boundary intervals
get_regression_label: get a regression target value for galaxy merger time given a task type like normalized or unnormalized regression
normalize_physical_feature: normalize a physical feature like redshift or mass to a [-1, 1] range using predefined min and max values
